tool.name: get_network_info
tool.description: Get network interface information including IP addresses and connectivity status.

when_to_use.trigger: User wants to see IP addresses

parameters.param: Specific interface to check (e.g., 'eth0', 'wlan0', 'enp0s3'). Leave empty to show all interfaces.

safety_rules.rule: This is a read-only tool - always safe to execute
Output limited to 500 characters per interface
